# We imagine    possible futures

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [Study and Advocacy Centers](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia)
- Imagining Futures

#### We transform uncertainty into opportunity

So that Latin America can imagine, design, build and lead its futures.

We anticipate trends at the intersection of education, work, and technology, connecting visions with capabilities that generate real impact in our region.

###### We inspire

Conversations about possible futures that guide ecosystems in matters of education, work and technology.

###### We created

Navigation tools, actionable foresight frameworks, and spaces for cross-sector collaboration.

###### We transform

Educational, organizational, social, and cultural paradigms.

## That's how we do it

![](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/43984ccd-7f98-4bad-8173-a0a26de0b6d7/web/destacado-asi-lo-hacemos.jpg?w=480&itok=nw8l9YEO)

## Futures Radar

What critical trends should you have on your radar? Access reports with emerging signal analysis, customized executive sessions by ecosystem, and diagnostic tools that help you make strategic decisions ahead of your competition.

[Learn more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia/imaginar-futuros/radar-de-futuros)

![](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/3acf1c18-726e-46e0-bf20-80cef24a801a/web/destacado-asi-lo-hacemos2.jpg?w=480&itok=2l7jkPsY)

## Conversations about the Future

Connect with the most dynamic ecosystems and thought leaders in spaces designed for strategic dialogue. Here, ideas meet, visions align, and transformative collaborations are born.

![](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/19943cf1-1dac-49ef-ab15-41f799845ce7/web/destacado-asi-lo-hacemos3.jpg?w=480&itok=7e0dPR4I)

## Narratives of the Future

The future needs to be told. Immerse yourself in content that makes emerging trends visible: podcasts with experts, visual reports, specialized newsletters, and analyses that translate complex signals into actionable insights for your organization.

[Listen to the conversations](https://www.youtube.com/@imaginarfuturoseafit)

![](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/03d347d9-d477-404e-b409-46d4cd92665d/web/destacado-asi-lo-hacemos4.jpg?w=480&itok=rpsBQ9jU)

## Strategic Advisory Council

We support boards of directors and leadership teams in navigating complex transformations, translating emerging signals into specific strategies for your context and connecting you with the EAFIT capabilities you need.

![Scroll icon](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/4b28e37a-a8e7-4a2e-96a3-b879c1dea309/web/manito.gif?animate=true)

### Strategic Lenses

We observe, analyze, and influence changes in the environment from three fundamental perspectives. The true richness lies in the intersections where these lenses overlap.

![Image Education](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/6a2921e2-08f9-43e2-b631-2d8ee92b8762/web/lentes-estrategicos-imaginar-futuros.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=397&h=253&itok=uWuAQuOd)

Education

We analyze the evolution of pedagogical models, educational institutions, and lifelong learning trajectories,

considering new forms of

knowledge acquisition and certification.

![Image Technology](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/21cf37dc-5c35-49ee-b2f8-73f148a6cf1c/web/lentes-estrategicos-imaginar-futuros2.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=397&h=253&itok=TzXL_FSA)

Technology

We examine the impact of technology on social, cultural, educational, and productive systems, exploring both its opportunities for

transformation and the challenges it presents.

![Image Work](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/8f55aaf8-0cca-4a60-8b4b-105323f26ac4/web/lentes-estrategicos-imaginar-futuros3.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=397&h=253&itok=Rfs63bgn)

Job

We address changes in productive and value-creating activities, including labor relations, trades, entrepreneurship, the digital economy, and emerging forms of work organization.

### FAQs

- [What is our competitive advantage?](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia/imaginar-futuros#3785945213-2714501218-1)

[What is our competitive advantage?](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia/imaginar-futuros#3785945213-2714501218-1)

Tenemos la capacidad de traducir tendencias en estrategias ejecutables para organizaciones y líderes regionales a través de los diferentes centros o escuelas de EAFIT. No solo estudiamos el futuro: lo hacemos posible.

[How can I participate?](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia/imaginar-futuros#3785945213-2714501218-2)

Puedes acceder a nuestros informes trimestrales, participar en nuestras conversaciones de futuros, solicitar consejería estratégica para tu organización, o seguir nuestras narrativas a través de contenidos audiovisuales, podcasts y boletines.

[What methodology do we use?](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia/imaginar-futuros#3785945213-2714501218-3)

Trabajamos con el framework de prospectiva estratégica: observamos señales y tendencias, imaginamos futuros posibles, diseñamos rutas estratégicas y activamos conversaciones que se convierten en productos y soluciones EAFIT.

[Who do we work with?](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia/imaginar-futuros#3785945213-2714501218-4)

Colaboramos con organizaciones como Empresarios por la Educación, Alianza 4U, Tecnológico de Monterrey, Comfama, Cámara de Comercio de Medellín y Colombia Edtech, entre otros aliados estratégicos.

[View all ->](https://www.eafit.edu.co/centros-estudio-incidencia/imaginar-futuros#)
